Package utilities

Interface ListADT

All Known Implementing Classes:
MyArrayList, MyDLL
public interface ListADT
A Linear List ADT interface used as the foundation for linear data structures in CPRG 304 at SAIT.

Implementing classes must define standard list operations such as insertion, deletion, access, search, and iteration. All index parameters are zero-based unless otherwise noted.

Design Note – String-Specific Implementation:
This interface is intentionally designed to work with String elements only. A fully reusable, type-safe design would use Java generics (e.g., ListADT<E>), allowing any object type to be stored in the list. Generic programming is outside the scope of CPRG 304 and has therefore been omitted. All element parameters and return types are fixed as String throughout this interface and its implementations.

  • Method Details

    • size

      int size()
      Returns the number of elements currently in the list.
      Returns:
      the current size of the list; never negative

    • clear

      void clear()
      Removes all elements from the list, leaving it empty. After this call, size() returns 0.

    • add

      boolean add(int index, String toAdd) throws NullPointerException, IndexOutOfBoundsException
      Inserts the specified String element at the given index, shifting all existing elements at or beyond that position one place to the right.
      Parameters:
      index - the zero-based position at which to insert the element; valid range is [0, size()]
      toAdd - the String element to insert; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the insertion was successful
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if toAdd is null
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if index < 0 or index > size()

    • add

      boolean add(String toAdd) throws NullPointerException

      Parameters:
      toAdd - the String element to append; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the element was successfully added
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if toAdd is null

    • addAll

      boolean addAll(ListADT toAdd) throws NullPointerException
      Appends all String elements from the specified list to the end of this list, in the order they are returned by the provided list's iterator.
      Parameters:
      toAdd - the list whose String elements are to be appended; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if this list changed as a result of the call
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if toAdd is null or contains null elements that are not supported

    • remove

      String remove(int index) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException

    • remove

      String remove(String toRemove) throws NullPointerException
      Removes and returns the first occurrence of the specified String element from the list, if it is present. Subsequent elements are shifted left by one.

    • indexOf

      int indexOf(String toFind) throws NullPointerException
      Returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of the specified String element in this list.

      If the element is not found, this method returns -1.

      Parameters:
      toFind - the String element to search for; must not be null
      Returns:

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if toFind is null

    • toArray

      String[] toArray(String[] toHold) throws NullPointerException
      Copies the String elements of this list into the provided array in proper sequence (first to last). If the array is large enough, elements are stored starting at index 0; otherwise, a new array of sufficient size is allocated and returned.
      Parameters:
      toHold - the String array into which list elements are to be stored; must not be null
      Returns:
      a String array containing all elements of this list in order
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if toHold is null
